text:
sarah: Quick FYI — planning to land a small terraform change today to add route filtering for PrivateLink + route-table tagging on internal RTs. Goal: avoid TGW-propagated routes leaking into app subnets and make the PL routes explicit. Will open a PR to apply in dev -> canary prod. Any concerns? cc @ben @kai

ben: sounds reasonable. Can you paste the minimal HCL you intend to apply so I can eyeball for side-effects?

sarah: sure, here's the snippet I'm going to include in the PR:

```
resource \"aws_route_table\" \"internal\" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  tags   = merge(var.common_tags, { \"route-filter\" = \"privatelink\" })
}

resource \"aws_route\" \"privatelink_to_pl\" {
  route_table_id                 = aws_route_table.internal.id
  destination_prefix_list_id     = aws_prefix_list.pl_service.id
  vpc_endpoint_id                = aws_vpc_endpoint.pl.id
  depends_on                     = [aws_vpc_endpoint.pl]
}
```

Note: using a prefix list for the service IPs so we don't open 0.0.0.0/0 accidentally.

kai: question — what about TGW route propagation? We currently have propagations into these RTs from the TGW attachment. If propagation remains on, the explicit route might be overwritten or conflict.

sarah: good catch. Plan is to disable propagation for the specific internal RTs before the change (we can do this via terraform by removing the aws_route_table_propagation resource or explicitly setting the propagation resource to false). For canary I'll do it in one dev AZ first so we can monitor onprem traffic.

ben: please coordinate with SRE — removing propagation can affect onprem paths. Canary in a single AZ + smoke tests is safer.

olivia: also double-check PrivateLink endpoint policy and KMS grants. If the service or our endpoint is using SSE-KMS, the service principal will need decrypt/grant from the CMK. Who will own the key change?

sarah: I'll add a KMS grant in the PR as a placeholder and follow up with the exact principal. For now adding tag `redwood:pl-owner=sarah` to the endpoint and key so security can track it.

infra-bot: terraform plan finished: 3 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy. Plan URL: https://ci.redwood.internal/plans/2071123344

kai: can you include the exact command/workspace you ran so I can reproduce? e.g. `TF_WORKSPACE=dev terragrunt plan --terragrunt-non-interactive -out=plan.tfplan`

sarah: yep: `TF_WORKSPACE=dev terragrunt plan --terragrunt-non-interactive -out=plan.tfplan`. I'll run that and then the canary apply in dev. PR in ~10m.

ben: :eyes: will review once PR is up. Ping me if you want a quick pairing review before merge.

olivia: if this touches KMS/secrets, please add a short security blurb in the PR description and tag me for review.

sarah: will do — thanks all, posting PR now and will note the canary AZ + smoke tests in the description.
